narrative: Your application was denied because the model estimated a 43% probability that you would be a bad credit risk. This is not a claim that you will certainly default; it means the estimated risk was above the bank’s approval cutoff, so the loan could not be approved on the current terms. This long repayment horizon was the main reason the assessment leaned toward bad risk. The second most important factor was your credit-history rating, which in this case worked in your favour and reduced the estimated risk. Those positive signals were not enough to offset the strong concern raised by the long loan duration. To improve your chances, ask the lender to confirm the main reasons in writing and check that your credit-history and employment details are accurate.
